bio: This delightful, long-established family trattoria, in business for over a century, has the motto “Chi mangium nustran” (“here we eat local”) in a demonstration of its commitment to cuisine from the Lower Po valley, although other Italian dishes also feature on the menu. At midday, choose from a selection of simple, delicious and reasonably priced homemade dishes, while in the evening just one single tasting menu, concluding with the dessert trolley, is served....
